Function Documentation

int md3D_lire_profil_N_XYZ ( const char *  nom_fichier,
struct Param_struct *  par 
)

Read profil in case of n(x,y,z) index distribution.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Two ways of entering the refractive index in the stack for this function:

  • first way: enter an array of values (1,2,3,...) corresponding to complex refractive indices n1,n2,n3,... which values are defined in the profile file. Ex.: n1 = 1.5 +i0.5 n2 = 1.0 +i0.0 n_xyz = 1 1 2 1 2 2 ...
  • second way: enter two arrays, one for the real part and one for the imaginary part (facultative) of the refractive index. Ex.: Re_n_xyz = 1.5 1.5 1.0 1.5 1.5 ... Im_n_xyz = 0.5 0.5 0.0 0.5 0.5 ... ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
